handoff_package.objective: Continue the session-workflow / handoff-schema track. Immediate unblocked work is THIS ticket (0869353b, Handoff edge model): implement SessionRecord.emitted_handoff_ids/picked_up_handoff_ids, the target-less-then-bound-at-pickup write path, and the unclaimed-handoff backlog query, per spec c737328d R1/R2/R3. Once 0869353b is done, f35f4dd9 (embedded step-graph snapshot in session_handoff) becomes actionable, and once f35f4dd9 is done, 54114fc9 (deterministic Rust execution controller spec) becomes actionable — its other three dependencies (1a240fdc, 7563ce30, feb5784c) are already done.
open_escalations: No session-mcp/session-api MCP tool was available in this handoff-authoring session's tool grant (not present among granted or deferred tools) — this handoff_package field on a ticket is a fallback, not the dedicated session/handoff store. A fresh session with session-mcp access should migrate this into the proper handoff record and can then satisfy the mermaid step-graph rendering requirement this fallback cannot.
handoff_package.predecessor_session_note: Session that produced this handoff: closed epic 7e8bc1c3 (guidance corpus quick-win track) and its two children 95403a71 (entity disambiguation applyTo scoping) and 9cd886d5 (applyTo-class convention); tightened and promoted spec 1b654f30 (Planner/Worker two-tier routing) draft->reviewed->approved; created 527fc2cf (deferred rule-api-backed dynamic guidance) and 50092f61 (workspace/root-resolution investigation, NOT a read-index staleness bug); rescoped 54114fc9 as an umbrella architecture ticket gated on 0869353b via f35f4dd9, reusing existing ticket-api enforcement (enforce_dependency_progress, SchemaRegistry transitions, WorkflowModel frontier computation) and SessionWorkflowNodeStatus rather than a new state enum. Commits: 1e86faa2 (applyTo frontmatter across 20 orchestration files + README convention), 3e389b00 (spec 1b654f30 tightening + promotion), 74034b1a (ticket closures/creates: 95403a71, 9cd886d5, 7e8bc1c3 done; 527fc2cf, 50092f61 created; 54114fc9 depends_on f35f4dd9 added).
